hints.title: Two Phase Mark and Drop Simulation
hints.text: In each round, identify all horizontal and vertical triplets of identical non-zero values, then drop remaining values downward.

hints.title: In-Place Tagging Using Absolute Values
hints.text: Tag matched candies by inverting their sign to negative, using absolute value comparisons so already tagged candies can still participate in perpendicular matches.

hints.title: Gravity Compaction and Convergence
hints.text: Iterate column by column from bottom to top, copying positive values down. Fill top cells with 0. Repeat until no candies are tagged in a full round.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O((R * C)^2) worst-case time with O(1) auxiliary space modified in-place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Crushing cells immediately prevents recognizing cross-shaped matches where horizontal and vertical triples intersect.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sign tagging allows in-place match recognition without auxiliary boolean grids.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly separate the tagging phase from the gravity collapse phase.
